name: alibaba/qwen3-vl-8b-instruct
description: Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct is the 8-billion-parameter dense, non-thinking edition of Alibaba's open-weight Qwen3-VL vision-language family. Alibaba notes it needs less GPU memory while keeping the series' upgraded image and video understanding, long-document and long-video handling, spatial awareness, object recognition, multilingual OCR and GUI agent abilities. Pick it for lighter multimodal deployments; the 30B A3B and 235B A22B models trade size for more capability.
